title: Number of Islands
contract: Count four-directionally connected groups of 1 in a nonempty rectangular binary grid.
brute: int rows=grid.length,cols=grid[0].length;int[] label=new int[rows*cols];Arrays.fill(label,-1);int count=0;for(int r=0;r<rows;r++)for(int c=0;c<cols;c++)if(grid[r][c]==1){int id=r*cols+c;label[id]=id;count++;for(int[] d:new int[][]{{-1,0},{0,-1}}){int nr=r+d[0],nc=c+d[1];if(nr<0||nc<0||grid[nr][nc]==0)continue;int old=label[nr*cols+nc],next=label[id];if(old!=next){for(int i=0;i<label.length;i++)if(label[i]==old)label[i]=next;count--;}}emit("Merge neighboring land labels by scanning all cells","cell",new int[]{r,c},"labels",label,"islands",count);}return count;
optimal: int rows=grid.length,cols=grid[0].length,count=0;boolean[][] seen=new boolean[rows][cols];for(int r=0;r<rows;r++)for(int c=0;c<cols;c++)if(grid[r][c]==1&&!seen[r][c]){count++;Deque<int[]> q=new ArrayDeque<>();q.add(new int[]{r,c});seen[r][c]=true;while(!q.isEmpty()){int[] cell=q.remove();for(int[] d:DIRS){int nr=cell[0]+d[0],nc=cell[1]+d[1];if(nr>=0&&nr<rows&&nc>=0&&nc<cols&&grid[nr][nc]==1&&!seen[nr][nc]){seen[nr][nc]=true;q.add(new int[]{nr,nc});}}emit("Visit one land component","cell",cell,"visited",seen,"islands",count);}}return count;
reasoning: Assign land labels and merge connected labels by scanning the label array, a correct but costly baseline.
A flood traversal from each unvisited land cell marks one entire island.
Only horizontal and vertical neighbors connect here. Mark on enqueue to avoid duplicate visits; a separate visited grid keeps the input unchanged.
